items.summary_en: Impeccable is a design vocabulary for coding agents: install it with npx impeccable install, run /impeccable init inside your agent, and you get commands like polish, bolder, critique and audit to steer and review UI output, catching formulaic AI-generated design before it ships. It works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI and other tools, and targets developers who care about visual quality.

items.title: 不再逐个生成 Token：扩散模型迈向 35B，开始挑战 Agent 编程

items.summary_en: Shenzhen startup DiffuSpace has open-sourced Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, a diffusion language model on a 35B-parameter MoE backbone that activates about 3B parameters per inference and hits 680 tokens/s in the company's own tests. In a drone airspace demo it finished in 7.32 seconds against 62.3 seconds for Qwen3.5. The open question is whether parallel decoding keeps its edge at larger scale and on agent tasks.

items.summary_en: An independent developer built HawkEye Print after tiring of jagged, blurry phone prints on Brother DCP-B7520DW-class wireless printers. It skips Android's 150–300 DPI grayscale conversion, rasterizes locally at 600/1200 DPI into 1-bit dot streams and sends them straight to the printer over RAW 9100 or IPP 631. It also bundles 30 Windows fonts so .docx files keep their typefaces, plus a remote gateway that needs no public IP.

items.summary_en: Snowflake's Snowpipe Streaming Elastic Channels is now generally available, letting producers write straight into Snowflake through a server-managed implicit channel and dropping Kafka, Schema Registry and connectors from the pipeline. Latency falls from minutes to seconds, at the cost of at-least-once delivery with no ordering guarantee. The article walks through a working setup, from creating objects to transforming data with Dynamic Tables and monitoring the channel.

items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者记录了自己从 Cursor 切换到 Codex、使用大半个月后的真实感受：Cursor 让他第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的冲击，而 Codex 更像一个真正的超级 Agent，而不只是编程助手。作者判断 Codex 更接近下一阶段的形态，适合在编辑器内置助手和 Agent 型工具之间做取舍的人参考。
items.summary_en: A developer writes up roughly half a month of using Codex after switching from Cursor. Cursor was what first made AI-assisted coding feel striking, he says, but Codex reads less like a coding assistant and more like a genuine super-agent, closer to the next stage of the tooling. Useful for anyone weighing an editor-integrated assistant against an agent-first workflow.

items.title: 活动回顾｜InfoQ AI 侦察团的实战一天：企业 AI 如何走向落地？
items.summary_zh: 10 月 22 日，InfoQ 联合中欧国际工商学院 EMBA 课程部、独角兽创业营与 TGO 鲲鹏会，在 QCon 上海 2026 首次集结「AI 侦察团」，带企业决策者从主论坛走到午餐圆桌和闭门私董会。下午的技术专场由阿里云、亚马逊云科技、去哪儿、腾讯、优码云的一线专家拆解 Agent 落地与组织复利等实践，适合正为场景选型和效果衡量发愁的企业团队。
items.summary_en: InfoQ's AI Scout Group held its first outing at QCon Shanghai 2026 on October 22, co-organized with the EMBA program at 中欧国际工商学院, 独角兽创业营 and TGO 鲲鹏会. Members moved from the 1,200-person main forum to a lunch roundtable and a closed-door board meeting, then heard engineers from Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Qunar, Tencent and 优码云 break down agent deployment and organizational reuse, which is useful for enterprises still choosing scenarios and metrics.

items.title: Grafana Tempo 3.1 新增基于查询的追踪数据脱敏功能以及支持采样机制的 TraceQL 指标
items.summary_zh: Grafana Labs 发布 Tempo 3.1：Kafka 客户端补齐 TLS/mTLS 与 SCRAM、OAUTHBEARER、AWS_MSK_IAM 等 SASL 机制，vParquet5 成为默认块格式，简单指标查询速度接近翻倍。tempo-cli redact 现在支持用 TraceQL 查询而非 trace ID 列表来脱敏，并可先用 --dry-run 统计匹配项；另有一项针对采样数据的实验性查询时提示。
items.summary_en: Grafana Labs shipped Tempo 3.1, the first point release on the Kafka-based 3.0 architecture: the Kafka client gains TLS/mTLS plus SCRAM, OAUTHBEARER and AWS_MSK_IAM SASL mechanisms, vParquet5 becomes the default block format, and simple metric queries run nearly twice as fast. The tempo-cli redact command now accepts TraceQL queries instead of trace ID lists, with a --dry-run mode, and sampled TraceQL metrics get an experimental query-time hint.

items.title: togg53192-cmd/jailbreaks
items.description: LIST OF ALL MY JAILBREAKS
items.author: togg53192-cmd

items.summary_en: The GitHub repo togg53192-cmd/jailbreaks gathers 32 prompts aimed at more than 26 models, including full system prompts, persona locks, workspace policies, AGENTS.md files and Ollama Modelfiles, each meant to be complete and paste-ready rather than excerpted. Coverage runs from free stealth models on OpenCode Zen and open-weight families like GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi and Qwen to closed models such as Claude, Gemini, Grok and Mistral. Aimed at people probing prompt boundaries and agent configuration.

items.title: Apple's git still trusts the compromised eMudhra certificates
items.author: galadran
items.summary_zh: Apple 在接到 eMudhra CA 被攻破的通知 11 天后，macOS 自带的 git、curl 和 python3 仍信任这批已失效的证书。也就是说，用系统自带工具拉代码或发起请求的开发者仍可能被中间人攻击，需要自己检查信任链并手动移除该根证书。
items.summary_en: Eleven days after Apple was notified that the eMudhra certificate authority had been compromised, the git, curl and python3 binaries shipped with macOS still trust the affected certificates. Anyone pulling code or making TLS connections with those system tools stays exposed to interception until the root is removed by hand, so macOS developers should check their trust store.

items.summary_en: Mistral released the weights of Mistral Large 4, codenamed Le Chonk — a 1T-parameter multimodal model that it describes as the best open-weight model for coding, trained in Europe. For teams that want to self-host or fine-tune a frontier-scale coding model instead of calling an API, this is now a trillion-parameter option they can download and run themselves.

items.title: 最后一天赶紧蹬，Codex 200刀额度砍半，ChatGPT入口大更新

items.title: We should be more ambitious with the software we build
items.author: ltratt
items.summary_zh: 一篇主张“我们应当把软件做得更有野心”的文章，以 Michael Malis 用 Rust 重写的 Postgres 项目 pgrust 为例：外界对疑似 AI 生成的项目普遍怀疑，但 pgrust 的测试细致到挖出 Postgres 自身的多个真实 bug，涉及 SP-GiST 数值、JSONPath 格式缓存、pgcrypto 与 money 溢出。适合想厘清 AI 辅助开发质量边界的人阅读。
items.summary_en: An essay arguing that developers should be more ambitious about what they build, using pgrust — Michael Malis's Rust rewrite of Postgres — as the case in point. The author acknowledges the widespread skepticism toward AI-generated projects, then notes that pgrust's testing is thorough enough to have surfaced real Postgres bugs, including SP-GiST numeric errors, a JSONPath format cache bug, pgcrypto failures and a money overflow. Relevant to anyone judging where AI-assisted work actually holds up.

items.title: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
items.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
items.author: milind-soni
items.summary_zh: OpenMausBot 是开源的 Grok Bot 替代品，以 TypeScript、React 19 和 Electron 构建的桌面应用；侧栏里每个 bot 都是本地运行的 Claude 或 Codex agent，各有独立人格、模型、云电脑和已连接应用，关键操作需用户审批。项目原名 OpenGrokBot，与 xAI、Meta、OpenAI、Manus 均无关联，适合想自托管多 agent 桌面的开发者。
items.summary_en: OpenMausBot is an open-source alternative to Grok Bot, shipped as an Electron desktop app built with TypeScript and React 19. Each bot in the sidebar is a real local agent, Claude or Codex, with its own personality, model, cloud computer and connected apps, and users approve what matters as they would with a contact. Formerly OpenGrokBot, it is unaffiliated with xAI, Meta, OpenAI or Manus, aimed at developers who want self-hosted multi-agent setups.

items.title: elayadesign/ai-design-skills
items.author: elayadesign
items.summary_zh: ai-design-skills 是 elayadesign 维护的设计技能集合，面向 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Windsurf 等会读取 markdown 规则文件的 AI 编程工具，每个技能是一个可独立安装的文件夹。目前提供 landing-page-design，涵盖页面结构、转化文案以及字体、间距、圆角、动效等视觉规范，适合希望 AI 按统一设计标准产出页面的开发者。
items.summary_en: ai-design-skills is a collection of design skills from elayadesign for AI coding tools that read markdown rule files, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Windsurf. Each skill is a self-contained folder you install individually; the first, landing-page-design, covers intake questions, page structure, conversion copy and a visual system of type, spacing, radius and motion. Useful if you want AI-generated pages to follow a consistent design standard.

items.title: Sebastian Raschka's from-scratch video course on building reasoning models
items.author: sgiannopoulos
items.summary_zh: Sebastian Raschka 发布了一套从零构建推理模型的视频课程，累计超过 11 小时的编码视频，内容覆盖评测、推理时扩展（inference-time scaling）、强化学习与蒸馏，代码使用 Python 和 PyTorch。适合想弄清推理模型训练全流程、而不满足于调用 API 的开发者。
items.summary_en: Sebastian Raschka has released a from-scratch video course on building reasoning models: more than 11 hours of coding footage covering evaluation, inference-time scaling, reinforcement learning and distillation, written in Python and PyTorch. It's aimed at developers who want to see how reasoning models are actually trained and evaluated, rather than just calling an API.

items.title: JetBrains/thinkrail
items.description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need
items.author: JetBrains
items.summary_zh: ThinkRail 是 JetBrains 的孵化项目，一款 agentic IDE：它在 npm 包 @earendil-works/pi 提供的 pi 编码 agent 之上搭了完整界面，把任务隔离到独立 workspace，并用 living specs 与可复用 skills 让 agent 积累持久的项目知识。官方表示下一步将加入完整扩展支持，让它按你的实际工作方式生成所需工具。
items.summary_en: ThinkRail is a JetBrains incubator project: an agentic IDE built on the pi coding agent from the @earendil-works/pi npm package, wrapping it in a full interface, isolating each task in its own workspace, and giving the agent durable project knowledge through living specs and reusable skills. JetBrains says full extension support comes next, so the IDE can generate the tools it needs from how you actually work. It targets developers who want agents handling whole tasks rather than autocomplete.

items.summary_en: obra/superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology built on composable skills plus initial instructions your agent is meant to follow. Its README documents setup for many coding tools, including Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI. It targets developers who want their coding agent to follow a repeatable engineering process instead of improvising.

items.title: nightly-labs/openbot
items.description: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.
items.author: nightly-labs
items.summary_zh: OpenBot 是 nightly-labs 的本地优先桌面工作区，让 Codex、Claude 等 agent 各有独立工作区和对话，并内置任务队列、文件传输、内嵌浏览器与 agent 间的消息通信。它通过 ACP 还能接入 Grok CLI、Gemini 等，适合同时管理多个编程 agent 的开发者；但目前仍是开发预览版，agent 默认拥有完整访问权限且不询问审批，只适合运行可信任务。
items.summary_en: OpenBot is a local-first desktop workspace from nightly-labs that gives each AI agent its own workspace and conversation, plus task queues, file transfer, an embedded browser and agent-to-agent messaging. It runs the Codex App Server and Claude Code natively and adds Grok CLI, Gemini, Cursor CLI and others over ACP. It suits developers juggling several coding agents, but it's a dev preview where agents run with full access and no approval prompts.

The write-up covers the friction hit during migration and the money saved along the way, which makes it useful for developers weighing a move away from their current AI coding tool.

items.title: Donchitos/Claude-Code-Game-Studios

items.description: 麦克风硬件音频采集唤醒为 0 次；真正实现未卜先知的，是 公网 NAT 时空超图（ST-GNN）、现代隐私集合求交（PSI） 与 端侧微模型特征向量化（On-Device Em

items.summary_en: A developer captured 72 hours of phone traffic and found zero microphone wake-ups at the hardware level, which weakens the "my phone is listening" theory. The uncanny precognition instead traces to public NAT spatio-temporal hypergraphs (ST-GNN), modern private set intersection (PSI), and on-device micro-model feature vectorization. Useful for engineers who want to understand how targeting actually works and where the privacy line sits.
